messages:
Priya: Heads-up: LumenQ SI go-live hit two issues during the on-site install: marketplace image signing check failed for private registry, and partner alerts aren't reaching partner-eng rotation. Partner is paused on step 3. Need quick mitigation so they don't roll back.

Marco: Oof. For the image signing, ops forgot to add the partner cert to the installer bundle for air-gapped installs. That's a packaging miss. We can patch the installer and push a hotfix image. ETA to build + sign: ~3 hrs.

Tess: For alerts, we don't currently forward vendor SI alerts to partner-eng unless the partner is in "early-stage" mode. We have a toggle but it requires an IAM change plus a PagerDuty mapping update. I can temp-forward manually if someone from PD ops can flip it.

Alex: Priorities: keep the field team unblocked, keep noise low, and document the workaround. Action plan: 1) Marco builds hotfix installer with partner cert and uploads to partner registry. 2) Tess prepares manual-forward steps + noise filters. 3) Priya coordinates sign-off with LumenQ to accept the hotfix.

Priya: I'm on partner side comms. They agreed to accept a signed hotfix if we provide checksum + brief install steps.

Marco: Drafting hotfix now. Quick install snippet for field eng: 

```
# on the field host
curl -O https://s3.redwood-release/hotfixes/lumenq-installer-v2.1.1.tar.gz
sha256sum lumenq-installer-v2.1.1.tar.gz  # verify: abcd1234...
sudo ./install.sh --allow-unsigned=false --extra-cert /tmp/lumenq-cert.pem
```

I'll attach cert and checksum to the release note.

Tess: Manual-forward plan: PagerDuty ops can create a temporary forwarding rule from prod-infra -> partner-eng for 48 hours. While active, apply alert filters: only forward on severity=critical OR tag=deployment. Also add a dedupe rule so partner-eng gets one consolidated page per incident. I'll open the PD ticket and paste filter config.

pagerbot: PD ticket #PD-4827 opened by Tess. Manual-forward assigned to PD-ops with ETA next business day morning. Automated routing change requires runbook PR + 24h review.

Priya: PD-ops contacted via phone and said they can toggle a forward for 24h tonight if we have an engineer on-call to cancel it if it floods. Can we commit to a shadow on-call?

Alex: I can be shadow tonight for 2am-6am PT. Marco can be available for the install window at 4am PT. Tess will coordinate PD ops. Priya will get partner sign-off now.

Marco: Hotfix build complete. Uploading artifact and pushing checksum to the ticket.

Tess: PD ops confirmed manual forward to partner-eng active at 03:30 PT. Filter applied: severity in [critical] OR label=deployment. Dedupe window 5min.

Priya: LumenQ confirmed they pulled the hotfix and completed step 3. Field team back to install checklist. No rollbacks. They asked for the short postmortem and the 'installer bundle checklist' to avoid future misses.

Alex: Great. Next steps: Tess to open runbook PR adding 'airgap installer cert checklist' + PD routing play (include manual-forward instructions). Marco to add installer signing check into CI and a canary test. Priya to share partner acceptance email into the PR. We'll do a 1-week follow-up retro.

Marco: Will add a CI job that verifies partner certs are present and a smoke canary against a private registry. PR incoming.

Tess: Opening runbook PR now: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/528 (contains PD temporary-forward steps + filter snippet).

Alex: Thanks everyone. Keeping this lightweight saved the rollout. Document everything so next SI can run this with the checklist. :thumbsup:
